title: Pressure in Liquids and Air
summary: Liquids push in all directions and harder with depth. The air above us presses too: atmospheric pressure.

ib.note: p = ρgh is formalised in MYP 5 / DP

cbse.chapter: Curiosity Ch 6: Pressure, Winds, Storms and Cyclones

objectives: I can describe how liquid pressure increases with depth and acts in all directions.
I can explain why dam walls are thicker at the bottom.
I can describe evidence for atmospheric pressure and explain how a straw or suction hook works.
misconceptions: Air has no weight and exerts no pressure.
We suck liquid up a straw (the air outside pushes it up).
